text:
Rik: quick ping — spotted inconsistent terminology between the help sidecar and docs. sidecar says 'route' in the Create flow but the docs use 'endpoint'.
Maria (Docs): ah. which flow exactly? can you paste the path?
Rik: Console > Routes > Create. sidecar title: 'Add a route', docs article heading: 'Create an endpoint'. file path in docs: /docs/console/routes#create-endpoint
Devon - Eng: thanks — this will affect our anchor-slug resolver. mismatch can break deep linking and analytics attribution.
Maria (Docs): i'd favour 'endpoint' as the canonical term (more standard). proposal: update sidecar copy, keep a parenthetical alias in docs like 'endpoint (aka route)' for a transition window.
Amanda (A11y): accessibility note: when users click deep links in the panel, focus doesn't move to the target content and screen readers aren't notified. we should either move focus programmatically or use aria-live regions.
Devon - Eng: agreed. plan: when a deep link is clicked we will close the sidecar, update the url hash, then call focus() on the destination heading. simple snippet: 
```
const el = document.getElementById(targetId);
if (el) {
  sidecar.close();
  el.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
  el.focus();
  history.replaceState(null, '', `#${targetId}`);
}
```
Also toggle aria-hidden on the sidecar to keep SRs out of the way.
Maria (Docs): i'll add canonical headings in the docs and an inline anchor for the sidecar to link to. also will add an alias line at the top: 'Terminology: endpoint (aka route)'.
Rik: can we add a tiny link icon next to in-panel section headers that deep-links into docs? users expect a quick jump.
Devon - Eng: doable. question for the team: should the link open in a new tab or navigate in-app? current behavior for docs links in sidecar is same-tab, but sometimes users want a new tab.
Amanda (A11y): same-tab is preferable if focus management is handled. if we open in new tab, update the aria-label to include "opens in new tab" and ensure target=_blank with rel=noopener.
Maria (Docs): i'll prepare copy variants for both patterns and recommend same-tab with focus landing. i'll also search the docs corpus for occurrences of 'route' so we can batch audit and update.
Rik: can someone file a tiny ticket with acceptance criteria: 1) update sidecar copy to 'endpoint'; 2) docs alias line; 3) add deep-link icon; 4) focus management & aria-hidden toggles; 5) analytics event fired on click.
Devon - Eng: filing INFR-2051 now — will include unit tests for focus and an e2e that validates deep-link behavior across SPA navigation. PR will reference docs updates.
docs-bot: created INFR-2051: "Console sidecar — terminology harmonization + deep-link accessibility" assigned to Devon - Eng, due in 10 days.
Maria (Docs): thanks — i'll queue a copy PR and send a list of 'route' hits so we can prioritize pages.
Rik: perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
